Service Requirements The Contractor must provide printing services, including the following tasks: • Graphic design and creation of annual report content for various Embassy offices. • Graphic design and creation of brochures, information portfolios, folders, advertising publications, flyers, and similar materials for the Embassy's promotional events. • Printing and/or photocopying of documents, brochures, and portfolios in a professional manner, ensuring clear colors, photographs, text, and images for finished products. Preference will be given to contractors offering multiple printing methods, such as commercial, digital, press, and web-based printing. • Supplying stock images for publications, as needed. • Providing printing designs for requesting offices to review and confirm prior to production. The Contractor is responsible for installing, setting up, and delivering printed items to U.S. Embassy Hanoi events. • Material Requirements: The Contractor shall present several material options for the Embassy's selection prior to submitting a quote. Services must include all necessary supplies — such as equipment, toner, developer, fuser agent, staples, paper, g

a. ALLTÖÖTLEJATE KASUTAMINE Teenuseosutajal ei ole õigust kasutada Teenuse osutamiseks teist Volitatud töötlejat (edaspidi „Alltöötleja“) ilma Ameti eelneva kirjaliku ja konkreetse nõusolekuta. Kui Teenuseosutaja kasutab Teenuse osutamiseks Alltöötlejat ja edastab talle Isikuandmeid, mille suhtes Amet on Vastutav töötleja, peab Teenuseosutaja tagama, et need Alltöötlejad täidavad Lepingu tingimusi nii, et Töötlemine vastaks Lepingu ja Andmekaitse õigusaktide nõuetele. Seejuures Teenuseosutaja vastutab Alltöötleja tegevuse eest samuti nagu enda tegevuse eest ning sõlmib Alltöötlejaga Isikuandmete töötlemiseks kirjalikud lepingud vastavalt GDPR artikli 28 lõikele 4. Juurdepääsu Isikuandmetele võivad saada ainult need isikud, kes vajavad neid oma ülesannete täitmiseks. Teenuseosutaja kinnitab, et kõigile tema Isikuandmeid töötlevatele töötajatele, sh ajutistele töötajatele, kehtib konfidentsiaalsuskohustus. Introduction The Administrative Office of the United States Courts (AO) is seeking contractor services for the printing and mailing of the following Internal Revenue Service (IRS) information returns: • W-2, Wage and Tax Statement • 1099-R, Distributions from Pensions, Annuities, Retirement or Profit-Sharing Plans, IRAs, Insurance Contracts, etc. • 1099-INT, Interest Income • 1099-MISC, Miscellaneous Income • 1099-NEC Nonemployee Compensation The printing and mailing support service will allow the Federal Judiciary to accomplish the requirement on the annual IRS tax reporting obligations. This contract will be for printing and mailing services ONLY and DOES NOT include the contractor providing any other tax-related services. The AO will provide ready-to-print and mail Portable Document File (PDF) data files to the contractor with all W-2 and 1099 boxes prepopulated with the appropriate tax information along with appropriate instructions of each tax form. The contractor must have the capability to securely receive and store electronic files from the AO using AO approved encryption methods such as Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) for files in-transit and hard disk encryption for files at-rest.
